Title: [LSJ] Madness Network and Meddling of Semsith

Messages.Author: Kamel SENNI
Messages.Body:
Meth A have a Madness Network in play.
Meth B is the methuselah chosen by a Meddling of Semsith.

The malky's controlled by the meth A can take actions, before OR after
meth B draw card to complete his hand ?

I would say before, because malky's take actions (with MN) just after
the methuselah B finish the actions of his minions, and he have to
fulfill his hand at the end of his minion phase.

Thanx in advance (and sorry for my bad english...).

Kindred SPIRIT
